title: freq is not a qt.run / QT_CONFIG key
summary: Passing freq or run_freq into qt.run or QT_CONFIG raises config_key is not a built-in parameter key.
narrative: freq / run_freq must not be passed to qt.run() or QT_CONFIG. Put it on Operator(..., run_freq=...). That mistake raises: config_key is not a built-in parameter key.
python_code:
import qteasy as qt
op = qt.Operator(strategies=['macd'], run_freq='d')
# Wrong: qt.run(op, freq='d')
qt.run(op, mode=1, asset_pool='000300.SH', invest_start='20180101', invest_end='20231231')
risk_notes: Ask explains this error; it does not call qt.run.
